On Mar 11, 2028, Tessa Morgan wrote:
> Tom / Alex / team —
>
> Thanks for taking the time to look at Acme Health's private deployment observability plan...

Quick notes from the runtime side:
- Our private forwarder (v2.4) can operate in two modes:
  1) outbound HEC push (client TLS/mTLS) to a customer-managed endpoint, including token-based HEC auth; or
  2) reverse pull via a customer-configured relay (TLS, mutual auth optional) where the relay pulls from an internal queue.
- We prefer mTLS for integrity and automated rotation, but we can support one-way TLS with token auth if policy prevents mTLS cert issuance.
- IP allowlisting: we can provide a stable set of egress IPs for Dedicated but not for ephemeral Hosted bursts. For on-prem deployments the forwarder uses the host network so Acme controls egress.
- Audit evidence we can ship: forwarder config snapshots, runtime audit logs (signed), cert rotation events (timestamps), and SHA256 hashes of shipped artifacts. See the attached evidence_matrix for mapping.

Questions for Acme / Splunk:
- Does Acme require certificate pinning against a corporate CA or will an intermediate signed by your CA be fine?
- For retention proof, is an attestable S3/GCS object with lifecycle metadata acceptable, or do you need a Splunk-side retention config screenshot?

I'm copying Jonas to confirm trace hooks (span propagation headers) and Ben for the syslog/HEC payload mapping.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Product Security — Redwood Inference

Thanks for the details, Kimberly. A couple of practical constraints from Splunk side:

- HEC over mTLS is supported, but we recommend token + client cert for layered auth. If you do mTLS only, ensure the Splunk HEC accepts client cert CN mapping to the token identity.
- Certificates: our infra teams prefer certs signed by an internal CA that we can validate; pinning to a specific CA fingerprint is OK. Rotation window: 90 days acceptable, 30 days preferred for high-security environments.
- Payload: compressed JSON lines over HEC is fine (gzip). We recommend batching to reduce connections: 1-5MB per batch, 30s flush for low-throughput tenants.
- Forwarder options: if you plan to run the forwarder in Acme's VPC, you can push directly to the HEC. If Redwood is initiating the connection from our Dedicated pool into Acme, we need an allowlist of egress IPs and a dedicated token per egress pool.

Attached a small config snippet we use for HEC TLS settings. Note the TLS min version and preferred cipher list.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Solutions Architect, Splunk

Thanks everyone 94 this is great, constructive feedback. To summarize and propose the binding we can implement immediately:

Decisions / agreed approach:
- Mode: Acme will run the forwarder inside the VPC (preferred). Redwood will provide configuration and cert rotation tooling; Splunk will accept HEC over mTLS + token.
- PKI: Acme will provide an internal CA for cert signing; Splunk to provide fingerprint for pinning. Rotation target 90 days (30 days for critical markets).
- Egress: where Redwood-managed egress is required (Dedicated), we'll supply a stable egress IP list and per-pool tokens. For on-prem, egress is controlled by Acme.
- Evidence: mandatory items: forwarder config snapshot, rotation events, signed audit logs. Nice-to-have: Splunk-side retention screenshot.

Open action items (owner / ETA):
- Acme (Tom): share CA fingerprint and preferred HEC port + any firewall rules by EOD Tue 2028-03-14.
- Splunk (Alex): confirm token issuance workflow and share final config snippet (Alex - by Mon 2028-03-13).
- Redwood (Kimberly & Jonas): produce a short runbook for forwarder install & cert rotation automation, and update evidence_matrix.xlsx to mark required fields (Kim / Jonas - Wed 2028-03-15).
- Redwood (Ben): provide the egress IP list for Dedicated pools (Ben - Wed 2028-03-15).

I've scheduled a 30-min sync for Tue to walk through the runbook and firewall snippets: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/7b3a-telemetry-review

If everyone's aligned I'll update the egress_policy_draft.md to the agreed binding and attach a versioned evidence bundle after the runbook is complete.
